source_factors.object: truncated expected Republican wins K in Kamala-state Senate/Governor elections, scaled K/6
Republican-strength proxy = 1 - P(Democrats win all core four Senate races)
Republican-strength proxy = P(Republicans win any Biden-Trump Senate/Governor election)

methods: TRAIN-fitted absorption coefficient and unabsorbed pressure
chronology: Every source state must be from block_number < target block. Repeated target rows sharing the same relevant source state are collapsed to one episode.
support_rule: At least 20 TRAIN episodes and 5 DEV episodes per target/factor combination.
interpretation: This tests dynamic information transfer, not state-price equality or executable arbitrage.
